determinism.layout: the exact root-relative ASCII namespace .mathhead-run-audit-store-v6 with only objects/<first-two-digest-characters>/<64-lowercase-hex-digest> and runs/<first-two-digest-characters>/<64-lowercase-hex-digest> committed-file paths, where each bucket component MUST equal the first two characters of its following filename digest; namespace, role and bucket directories are exact private 0700 and committed or temporary regular files are exact private 0600 on supported POSIX hosts
determinism.listing: visible run identities are full lowercase digests sorted lexically after fresh validation
determinism.paths: path spelling, directory handles, device and inode identities, temporary names and platform separators are effect-only
determinism.record: strict duplicate-rejecting compact sorted ASCII JSON with one LF, NFC strings, bounded integers, sorted unique object identities and self hash
determinism.relocation: copying exact supported store bytes to another valid pinned root preserves every canonical identity and load result
determinism.result: identical supported root state and bundle bytes produce the same semantic result identity; stored versus existing is the only effect-state distinction

effects.cache: physical exact-byte deduplication only; no semantic outcome reuse or lookup is authorized
effects.clock: none for canonical data, identity, ordering or correctness; filesystem timestamps are ignored
effects.filesystem: bounded descriptor-relative no-follow create, lstat/fstat, open, read, write, fsync, link and directory enumeration beneath one pinned root and its exact private .mathhead-run-audit-store-v6 namespace; immutable content and run records are append-only and no committed material is deleted
effects.memory: bounded bundle replay, canonical record construction, exact-byte verification and immutable result construction
effects.mutation: caller bundle is not mutated; supported platforms may append new immutable files beneath the pinned root
effects.persistence: content-addressed objects plus one immutable content-addressed run record installed last

ensures: The function freshly replays the exact bundle governed by MH-C-AUDITED-RUN-005 and MH-C-RUN-AUDIT-REPLAY-005 before writing and returns stored or existing only for a complete replay with exact manifest, logical report and object closure; invalid bundles produce a closed non-authoritative invalid result without a visible run reference.

The v3 run record binds the exact execution_provenance_sha256 from manifest v4 and logical report v3 in addition to the manifest, report, object closure and STORE-006 identity; load independently requires all four provenance references and exact bytes agree.

Current content and records live only beneath the exact .mathhead-run-audit-store-v6 namespace. Public persist, load and list never scan, parse, repair, overwrite, relabel or return legacy root, STORE-005, manifest-v3, object-v2, report-v2 or record-v2 bytes as current values.

On a platform lacking the descriptor-relative no-follow operations required to pin every directory and file identity, persistence returns one closed unsupported result before creating content and load/list raise a closed unsupported error.

The lexical root and every existing ancestor are captured as stable directory identities; every descendant create, inspect, read, link, synchronize and enumerate operation is relative to an opened no-follow directory handle and rechecks the captured root chain before and after the effect.

Renaming, replacing, linking or reparsing any root ancestor cannot redirect an operation into a replacement tree; it produces a closed non-success outcome and no object or run record is installed in the replacement tree.

Content bytes are installed as immutable SHA-256-addressed single-link regular files, exact existing bytes dedupe, conflicting or corrupted existing bytes fail, and manifest plus logical report are ordinary content objects bound by the run record.

The immutable run record is the sole commit point and is installed last only after every referenced object is synchronized; an interrupted operation may leave unreachable content but never a visible partial or falsely complete run.

Directory and file synchronization is capability-probed before content installation; EINVAL, ENOTSUP and EOPNOTSUPP are unsupported outcomes rather than successful durability, while all other synchronization errors are closed I/O outcomes.

A same-run concurrent writer converges only on byte-identical state; different runs remain independent; no operation overwrites, truncates, repairs, renames over or deletes a committed different byte string.

Load and digest-sorted listing freshly validate the pinned directory graph, exact records and objects, and complete replay before returning; corrupt, partial, linked, replaced or unsupported state is never ignored, while unreachable orphan content remains noncommitted.

Store and temporary paths, separators, owner and host identity, permissions, inode and link observations, clocks, temporary suffixes and filesystem order never enter canonical records, bundle bytes, logical reports or result identities.

The returned RunAuditStoreResult is one closed immutable stored, existing, invalid, unsupported or io_error value governed by MH-C-RUN-AUDIT-STORE-006 and mathhead.run-audit-store-result.v6 with mathematical_authority false.

Concurrent different-run writers, hardlinked content, ancestor replacement, every write and install interruption point, root and traversal-shaped paths, and explicit permission, capacity, synchronization, link, stat, read and write failures have named tests and remain closed non-success outcomes without replacement-tree effects or visible partial runs.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate after closing descriptors and removing only the operation's own uncommitted temporary file where safely possible.

Persist-only RunAuditStoreResult v6 has a closed status/reason/identity matrix: stored and existing alone retain exact manifest and record identities with positive bounded object count; invalid, unsupported and io_error retain neither identity, retain zero count, and use only their operation-independent exact reason set.

epistemics.authority: all store records and results have mathematical_authority false and cannot replace Evidence or Certificate authority
epistemics.dedupe: recognizes byte identity only and grants no semantic or cache authority
epistemics.invalid: corrupt, partial, missing, conflicting, linked, replaced, unsupported or over-budget state is not repaired or partially trusted
epistemics.load: returns only a freshly complete logical replay of exact committed bytes and does not trust filenames or recorded status alone
epistemics.persistence: proves only that exact bytes were committed under the supported pinned-filesystem contract, not that a mathematical claim is true

invariants: No operation accepts root itself, a relative path, parent traversal, lexical alias, link-like ancestor or a root deeper than the fixed component budget.

The exact .mathhead-run-audit-store-v6 namespace is the only current root-relative entry point and has only objects/<first-two-digest-characters>/<64-lowercase-hex-digest> and runs/<first-two-digest-characters>/<64-lowercase-hex-digest> committed-file grammar; each two-character lowercase hexadecimal bucket MUST equal the first two characters of the following 64-character lowercase hexadecimal filename digest; legacy siblings are outside current enumeration and cannot collide with or suppress a current manifest name.

Supported persistence requires descriptor-relative no-follow primitives for directory creation, file open, link installation and identity checks; capability absence is detected before content creation.
Every opened directory is compared with its no-follow lexical identity and every captured root ancestor identity remains stable around each effect; replacement never selects a new authority tree.

Every visible namespace, role and bucket component is a real exact private 0700 directory; every committed or temporary component is an exact single-link private 0600 regular file; on supported POSIX hosts each is owned by the effective user; every file has exact bounded length and an exact filename digest.
A content path never changes after installation; an existing path is reused only after handle-based exact-byte comparison and any difference is a conflict.
A run is visible as complete only when its immutable record exists and every named object plus manifest and logical report is exact and freshly replays complete.

The record execution-provenance identity equals the exact singleton provenance object digest and both manifest/report fields; repairing a record, manifest, report or object hash cannot substitute a historical implementation/configuration inventory.
Temporary files are created exclusively in the opened target directory, remain private and bounded, and are never listed or trusted as committed content.
The run record object inventory is sorted unique and exactly matches the manifest's physical closure including the logical report.
Same-run concurrency cannot create divergent bytes, different-run concurrency cannot share a mutable pointer, and directory enumeration order never changes listing.
Unsupported synchronization, directory anchoring, permission, capacity, link, stat, read or write behavior cannot return stored/existing result or returned loaded-bundle success.
Public store result values are final, immutable, constructor-owned, non-pickle authority and freshly revalidated before serialization.
No path, directory handle, inode, device, timestamp, permission, host, process or temporary observation appears in canonical bytes or changes mathematical classification.
Runtime constants bind STORE-006, run-audit-store-record v3 and run-audit-store-result v6; every other record/result schema is historical-only at this public boundary.
raises: RunAuditStoreError is raised by strict load/list/serialization accessors and for unrecoverable caller path, platform capability, filesystem identity or exact-type misuse with a closed kind covering type, path, link, mode, io, budget, missing, conflict, corrupt, partial or unsupported.
PermissionError and TypeError protect direct construction, subclassing and pickling of public store values.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit propagate unchanged after bounded local cleanup.
requires: MH-C-WORKFLOW-001 governs this critical persistent content-addressed serialization boundary.

root is an exact pathlib.Path naming a non-root absolute normalized lexical path and bundle is an exact closed RunAuditBundle governed by accepted MH-C-AUDITED-RUN-005=42e6cfcb704bc1b40b8c0a9143c4bfdaa34b0228a85621d9464e28c8481a39a7 and MH-C-RUN-AUDIT-REPLAY-005=cc1170556ddba8bf4232fff5dc14f1bdb95d7d558540d5066fb4379b9c1c2cde.

Only manifest-v4 bundles governed by AUDITED-RUN-005 with one exact run-execution-provenance-v1 object and fresh complete REPLAY-005 are eligible; AUDITED-RUN-001-through-004 bundles and STORE-005-or-earlier records remain immutable historical migration inputs and cannot be relabelled as current success.

The only current namespace is the exact single ASCII component .mathhead-run-audit-store-v6; its namespace, objects, runs and two-hex bucket directories are exact private 0700, committed and temporary regular files are exact private 0600, and on supported POSIX hosts every component is owned by the effective user.

The caller grants filesystem effects only beneath the pinned root identity; no path component, manifest field, object bytes, link target, environment value, clock, temporary token or external pointer may expand that authority boundary.
